messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: API best practice
parts:
Hi Josh,
Apologies for the delay, I forgot to close the loop after I got the response. There is no best practice today that we would recommend, putting the API key in the server.R file is just as secure as trying to put it in some other file within the application.   There may be techniques that make it so that you don't ever store the key on disk anywhere, for example you make a call out to a service on your side at application startup over SSL and that end point is locked down so it would only respond to calls from shinyapps.io. As you know none of these solutions are completely bulletproof unfortunately, but that could be a marginally better way to handle that.  We have batted around the idea of HSMs, but we aren't convinced that the overhead and complexity really buys you as much.  We are of course open to other suggestions if you have them.

As for adding users, it is absolutely our intention to provide such an api in the shinyapps package.  We have prioritized a few items like support for private github repos, improved support for various locales, making it easier for folks to see their billing cycle information, improving invoices, renaming accounts and finally support for application deletes.  Adding/removing users programmatically is at the top of the very next batch of work.

-Tareef
